text:
sanjay: prepping image rotation for private/VPC customers. target change window: Fri 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. will push v1.4.3-rc -> v1.4.3 final, plus airgap bundle update.

lisa: noted. do we have the canary host list? also need COSIGN keys from security.

kevin: canary list attached in prev thread, but a trimmed one for this rollout: canary-1, canary-2, staging-edge-3. i'll repost.

kevin: @sanjay re: cosign, security rotated k8s signing key last week — use cosign key id `cosign:2026-03-12-rot-3` and sign artifacts after packaging.

maria: packaging ETA is EOD tomorrow. dev-packager will run final checksum and manifest bump.

dev-packager: packaging done locally. two notes: 1) shrinkwrap created, 2) image tags include build metadata. sample commands I ran:```bash
sha256sum redwood-inference-private-installer-v1.4.3.tar.gz
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/cosign-key redwood-inference-private-installer-v1.4.3.tar.gz
```
outputs: `sha256:fa3e9b...d4b1` and cosign sig `cosign.sig.v1`

sanjay: perfect. can someone upload checksum + sig to S3 staging path and update the release manifest? path: `s3://redwood-private/releases/1.4.3/airgap/manifest.json`

dev-packager: uploaded checksums and signatures to staging. updated manifest with `image_pins` for registry mirrors and `installer_digest`. snippet:```json
{"installer_digest":"sha256:fa3e9b...d4b1","images":[{"name":"runtime","pin":"registry.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:aaa111"}]}
```

lisa: quick question — are we doing a soft-canary (10%) then full roll, or immediate pin swap?

kevin: plan is soft-canary first hour, observe latency/cpu/kvcache hit rates, then full swap if green. fallback: pin back to 1.4.2 and restore old manifest.

release-bot: :calendar: Release window reserved: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC -> 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. Canary autoscaler set to min=1,max=3.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Note: maintenance window overlaps with region-apac nightly backup. scheduled backups will be delayed by 30m. psas sent.

maria: i'm adding a short checklist in the release notes: cosign sigs present, manifest updated, canary hosts, rollback plan, postdeploy smoke. will paste link once ready.

sanjay: rollback decision criteria: any >3% error rate increase for 5min OR median latency >1.5x baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows => rollback. also if model quality regressions in eval tests triggered.

lisa: ack. can we also add automated manifest pin verification pre-commit step? small script to validate checksums before promoting.

dev-packager: filed PR with `verify-manifest-checksum.sh` and a small CI job. link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/412>

kevin: heads-up: customer X has a custom mirror; ops will coordinate post-swap customer-side sync. ops please confirm replication timing.

ops-bot: ops queue created P-1234, replication window scheduled +30m after full swap. notified PM and CSM.

maria: final preflight tomorrow 10:00 UTC. if anyone needs to test the signed bundle earlier ping me.

sanjay: thanks all. i'll kick the deployment at T-15 with the canary subset, and monitor dashboards/traces. will post a follow-up thread with rollout timeline and smoke-green timestamp. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks. tagging @release-bot to open the public release notes draft after canary passes.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Draft release notes created at `docs/releases/1.4.3.md`. will publish after manual approval.

lisa: one more, don't forget to increment `supported_vpc_manifest_version` in the installer config or some customers will fail on validate step.

dev-packager: updated installer config in staging. all good. rolling to CI for integration test now.

sanjay: excellent—closing here unless anything blocks. will update thread during rollout.
